Pemko 434_ARL Automatic Door Bottom

Features and Specifications of the Full Mortise Automatic Door Bottom:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Width: 27/32” (21.4 mm)
  • Height: 1-5/16” (33.4 mm)
  • Smooth action, positive seal mechanism.
  • An aluminum case surrounds a movable drop-bar seal.
  • The drop-bar seal is actuated by a plunger which contacts the jamb as the door is closing, forcing the drop-bar seal down against the floor / threshold.
  • Low Closing Force and Fully Mortise Application means this Drop Seal satisfies requirements for ANSI A117.1 and ADAAG 2010
  • This automatic door bottom is supplied with a EPDM Sponge ("R") insert - item number E4303BL (black color, only)

Product Testing

  • Air Infiltration Tested – Tested to ASTM E-283-04 (2012) for low air leakage allowance; allows no more than 0.3 cfm per square foot at 1.57 psf.
  • Sound Tested – Tested to ASTM E90 – 2009 in a single or in multiple sound seal configurations for sound attenuation in an opening
  • Smoke Tested – Tested to UL 1784 and meets the requirements of NFPA 105-2013 for smoke leakage in an opening; allows no more than 3.0 cfm per square foot at 0.10” water column (about 75 Pa).
  • Fire Rated – Tested to UL10B Standard Fire Tests and UL10C Positive Pressure Fire Tests of Door Assemblies
  • BHMA Certified – Tested for performance with regards to the requirements in: ANSI/BHMA A156.22 – Door Gasketing and Edge Seal Systems

Sold Individually
